rationales: .HTMT is not the standard HTML file extension.
.HTML is a standard extension for an HTML page.
.XATML is not a standard HTML file extension.
.DOCX is used for Word documents, not HTML pages.
Caesar used encryption to encode messages for his soldiers and generals.
Confidentiality is a security goal, not the name of Caesar’s method.
Client-server over one is not a recognized method of encoding messages.
A patent is a legal right, not a way to encode messages.
Passwords are used to authenticate users entering a system.
A web page is content, not an authentication credential.
A keyboard is an input device, not an authentication method by itself.
A network connects devices and does not authenticate a user by itself.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is the standard protocol for sending email between systems.
HTTP is primarily used to transfer web content.
A message is the data being sent, not an email-transfer protocol.
Protocol is a general term for communication rules, not the specific email protocol.
An algorithm is a sequence of steps, not a command for jumping to a particular step.
A flowchart is a diagram of an algorithm, not a transfer command.
The goto statement transfers control to a specified step or label.
Else introduces an alternative branch in a conditional statement.
Guess, check and improve involves testing guesses and refining them, not dividing tasks.
Divide and conquer breaks a problem into smaller tasks that can be listed and solved.
Act it out uses actions or simulation to work through a problem.
A prototype is an early model of a product, not a strategy for listing subtasks.
RAM is volatile memory because its contents are lost when power is turned off.
Non-volatile memory retains data without power, unlike RAM.
Indirect memory is not the standard classification of RAM.
Semi memory is not a standard memory category for RAM.
A number system is a system for representing numeric data.
Binary is one specific number system, not the general term requested.
Decimal is one specific number system, not the general term requested.
Octal is one specific number system, not the general term requested.
TCP/IP is a suite of protocols that supports communication between devices across networks.
OSI is a reference model, not the protocol suite used for end-to-end connectivity.
IPv4 is one version of the Internet Protocol, not a suite of protocols.
HTML is a markup language for web pages, not a networking protocol suite.
The application layer provides network services to applications rather than handling end-to-end message delivery.
The transport layer provides end-to-end communication between devices and their applications.
The network layer routes packets between networks rather than providing end-to-end transport.
The data link layer transfers frames over a local link.
Denial of service is one specific type of cybercrime, not the general term for such a crime.
Cybercrime is crime involving computer networks or devices.
Hard-disk loading is not the general name for a computer-related crime.
Piracy is a specific illegal copying or distribution activity, not the general term.
A virus is malicious software, not the act of illegally accessing a computer.
Hacking is unauthorized access to a computer or system.
Piracy is the illegal copying or distribution of protected works.
Decryption is converting encoded information back into readable form.
HTML is commonly explained through three key terms: elements, tags, and attributes.
HTML is not described by only two key terms in this context.
Three key terms—elements, tags, and attributes—are used to understand HTML.
Four is not the expected count of these basic HTML terms.
The body section begins with the opening <body> tag.
</body> is the closing tag for the body section.
<head tag is not a correctly formed HTML tag and refers to the head, not the body.
</head> closes the head section rather than starting the body.
A communication channel carries data between devices in a network.
An address identifies a device or destination but does not connect devices.
A client is a device or program that requests services, not the connection medium.
A server provides services to clients, not the connection medium.
